verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches the edges of this story. Dynadot supports renewing domains through API commands and WHMCS, and its WHOIS Watchlist can monitor expiry or status changes, which roughly stands in for expiry alerts. The documented 'grace deletion' covers returning newly registered domains (domain tasting), not post-expiry grace or redemption windows. Missing for 10: per-domain auto-renew controls, account-level expiry/renewal reminder emails, documented post-expiry grace and redemption periods with restore fees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
